memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then the Lord said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai, "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more." So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord. - Num 3:14-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God commands a special count of the Levites — every male a month old or more. This was different from the earlier census of fighting men, which counted only those twenty and over. Here, even the youngest infants were counted, because they belonged to God from the start.

There is something tender in this. God's claim on the Levites did not wait until they were old enough to be useful or strong enough to work. From one month old, they were counted as His. Belonging to God came first; service would come later.

This speaks to us about how God views the young and the small. In a world that often values people by what they can produce, God counts the tiniest child as precious and His own. Every life matters to Him from the very beginning.

And notice again the quiet phrase: Moses counted them "as he was commanded by the word of the Lord." Obedience to God's word runs through this whole book like a steady drumbeat.

Whatever your age or stage, whatever your abilities, you are counted by God not for what you can do, but because you are His. Jesus welcomed even little children, saying the kingdom belongs to such as these (Mark 10:14).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe God values you apart from what you produce?
- How can you honour the young and small as God does?
- Are you obeying God's word as Moses did?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You count me as Yours, not for what I can do, but simply because I belong to You. Help me to value every life as You do. Amen.
